description: INSERT OR REPLACE against an existing primary key value must overwrite every column named in its explicit column list -- Rewrite translates it to ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = excluded.name, note = excluded.note, using the table's real primary key (found via the same cached unique-key lookup sql_pkey.go already uses for pkey/ptable reporting) as the conflict target

body: INSERT INTO tD{{DLID}} (id, name, note) VALUES (1, 'orig', 'n1')
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO tD{{DLID}} (id, name, note) VALUES (1, 'updated', 'n2')
SELECT name, note FROM tD{{DLID}} WHERE id = 1
